summary: Phase 3 verification for Logistics Hub Expo app — 4 targeted tasks. All PASS. Source-level wiring of the ghost-typing fill_form tool, native WebRTC polyfill wrapper, mobile dark background, and hamburger drawer stacking all confirmed. Visual verification on mobile viewport 390x844 shows solid #07070f (rgb(7,7,15)) background on Dashboard, Ledger, Invoices, Trips, Shipments — zero white flashes. Hamburger opens drawer with dim scrim; tapping scrim closes it cleanly. No regressions detected in the Phase 3 scope.

task_results.task: 1. Ghost typing wired to fill_form tool
evidence: use-realtime-voice.ts:346-400 — dc.onopen sends session.update with fill_form tool schema (form enum incl. shipment_new, invoice_new, party_new, ledger_entry_new, trip_new; fields object; reason string; required=[form,fields]; tool_choice=auto).
use-realtime-voice.ts:240-268 — response.function_call_arguments.done handler parses args, validates form id against FILL_FORM_ROUTES, and calls dispatchFillForm({form, fields, reason}).
fill-form-bridge.tsx:23-51 — subscribeFillForm callback shows toast, emitGhostTypeStart(p.form) and router.push(FILL_FORM_ROUTES[p.form]).
_layout.tsx:22, 201 — FillFormBridge imported and mounted once at root, next to VoiceOrb.

shipment/new.tsx:437-521 — useEffect calls consumePendingFillForm('shipment_new') on mount AND subscribeFillForm for live updates. Applies source/origin → setOrigin, destination → setDestination, direction (IN_TO_TH/TH_TO_IN incl. Hinglish variants), mode (air/sea/land/hand_carry), carrier_name (deferred resolve at :526-539 when parties load), freight+currency (INR/THB), weight_kg (→ bag[0].weight_kg), bag_count (→ regenerates BAG-N rows), notes/description, consignment_no.
task_results.notes: window.__testDispatchFill is NOT exposed (spec says that is acceptable — verified via source-read as instructed). OpenAI Realtime cannot be invoked in test env, but the entire wiring chain is correctly plumbed.

evidence: src/utils/webrtc.ts:39-75 — getWebRTC() lazily resolves; on web reads window.RTCPeerConnection/mediaDevices; on native dynamically require()s react-native-webrtc inside try/catch and returns null on failure (no import-time crash in Expo Go). hasWebRTC() = getWebRTC() !== null.

use-realtime-voice.ts:24, 53, 289-290, 313, 318 — hook uses hasWebRTC() for `supported`, getWebRTC() for RTCPeerConnection + mediaDevices.getUserMedia. No hardcoded window.RTCPeerConnection references remain.
Web preview confirms Voice Orb path is active (supported branch works — no 'browser doesn't support WebRTC' error observed).
Runtime bg colors sampled at 390x844: root=rgb(7,7,15), body=rgb(7,7,15), html=rgb(7,7,15) on dashboard, ledger, invoices, trips, shipments. Matches #07070f.

Screenshots (/tmp/2_dashboard.png, /tmp/screen_ledger.png, /tmp/screen_invoices.png, /tmp/screen_trips.png, /tmp/screen_shipments.png) all show consistent deep-space background — no white slide-in flash captured.
sidebar.tsx:720-721 — hamburger style sets zIndex:100 and elevation:12 OUTSIDE Platform.select (unconditional).
sidebar.tsx:749-750 — mobileDrawer style sets zIndex:90 and elevation:20.
sidebar.tsx:478-481 — scrim Animated.View sets zIndex:80 and elevation:18 unconditionally.

Runtime: tapped [data-testid=sidebar-hamburger] → drawer visible=True, scrim visible=True. Tapping [data-testid=sidebar-scrim] closes drawer cleanly. Screenshots /tmp/3_drawer_open.png (drawer visible with nav items) and /tmp/4_drawer_closed.png (ledger visible again) confirm expected behavior.
